# Set-ZbxSla

## SYNOPSIS

Changes an SLA.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxSla [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixSlaRecord>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Period <ZabbixSlaPeriod>] [-Slo <double>] [-EffectiveDate <DateTimeOffset>] [-Timezone <string>] [-Status <ZabbixSlaStatus>] [-Description <string>] [-ServiceTag <ZabbixSlaServiceTagRequest[]>] [-Schedule <ZabbixSlaScheduleRequest[]>] [-ExcludedDowntime <ZabbixSlaExcludedDowntimeRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A service level agreement sets the uptime a set of services should reach in each reporting period, and reports what they reached. The Set-ZbxSla cmdlet changes the SLAs given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with sla.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every SLA the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed SLAs back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change an SLA

```powershell
Set-ZbxSla -InputObject 'Business hours SLA' -Slo 99.5
```

Lowers the objective of the SLA Business hours SLA to 99.5 percent.

### Example 2: Change an SLA and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxSla -InputObject 'Business hours SLA' -Slo 99.5 -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the SLA Business hours SLA back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixSlaRecord>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -Timezone (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixSlaPeriod`: Bound to -Period (ByPropertyName). The SLA period values: ZBX_SLA_PERIOD_* in defines.inc.php.
- `double`: Bound to -Slo (ByPropertyName).
- `DateTimeOffset`: Bound to -EffectiveDate (ByPropertyName).
- `ZabbixSlaStatus`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The SLA status values: ZBX_SLA_STATUS_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixSlaServiceTagRequest[]`: Bound to -ServiceTag (ByPropertyName). service_tags of a ZabbixSlaCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixSlaScheduleRequest[]`: Bound to -Schedule (ByPropertyName). schedule of a ZabbixSlaCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixSlaExcludedDowntimeRequest[]`: Bound to -ExcludedDowntime (ByPropertyName). excluded_downtimes of a ZabbixSlaCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixSlaRecord`: Sla record class.
